violations.text: Various foods in prep unit were observed held at (70-73) degrees Fahrenheit. PIC voluntarily disposed of all TCS foods located in prep unit. See attached disposal list. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026

Observed refuse area and enclosure with an accumulation of leaves. 5-501.115 Maintaining Refuse Areas and Enclosures. A storage area and enclosure for REFUSE, recyclables, or returnables shall be maintained free of unnecessary items, as specified under § 6-501.114, and clean. 5- New Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026

The fan covers located in walk-in cooler has an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026

Wood is used in the construction of bar top in the bar area. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other food soiling or that require frequent cleaning must be constructed of a nonabsorbent and smooth material. New Violation. Correct By: 12/26/2025

The ice machine is lacking an air gap. A direct connection must not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food is placed. New Violation. Correct By: 12/26/2025
